notes.t: If no prices can be loaded at all, it now says so (with why) instead of sitting on "Loading prices". Lifting the last finger after pinching the heatmap no longer counts as a tap.

Steadier Listen recordings: shorter pieces joined smoothly and steadier voice settings, to stop the voice drifting into a whisper. Page headers and page numbers are no longer read aloud. Calls you already recorded still play free.
Past calls you've already recorded with ElevenLabs show a green "Recorded" tag (or "Partly recorded"), so you can see where credits went. Those play free.

files.name: Borrower Credit
files.title: Borrower Credit
files.about: Household debt and delinquency (NY Fed)
files.sig: // Borrower Credit for Scriptable

notes.t: Fixed the Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac lines on the FHA delinquency chart: each report now fills in 13 months, so both lines rebuild back to 2015 over about two opens. If either site blocks the download, you'll see it in orange instead of a missing line.

FHA delinquency now compares against conventional loans: Fannie Mae's and Freddie Mac's serious delinquency, back to 2016 (fills in over a few opens). PDF: one Who slide with FICO, first-time vs repeat and DPA; the reasons slide says which reasons you hid.
Hiding a reason under FHA "Share by reason" now re-scales the reasons left to 100%, and the new-delinquencies count above shows only their loans. The sentence and the PDF follow.

files.name: Inflation
files.title: Inflation
files.about: Is inflation heading up or down? A scorecard of 8 signals: expectations, wages, oil, producer prices, rents, supply chains
files.sig: // Inflation Expectations Widget for Scriptable (small widget)

notes.t: A Fed calendar at the top (next FOMC meetings, minutes, Board speeches, in Central time). Open "What people expect" to see each group, with chips to hide them, plus forecasts running past Today: economists, Fannie Mae, the market model and the Fed's projections.

New: is inflation heading up or down? A scorecard of eight signals (today's pace, what people expect, wages, oil, producer prices, new-lease rents, long-run expectations, supply chains), with a chart for each and a two-slide PDF.

files.name: Chartbook

files.about: Release calendar of industry PDFs (Ginnie, Urban, ICE, Fannie, MBA commentary, HUD, Fed) and builder investor decks
files.sig: // Reports Widget (small): a release calendar for the industry reports you

notes.t: MBA Forecast Commentary picks up every edition on MBA's archive page, including ones MBA posted as a web page (like October 2026), which open in Safari.
Builder earnings-release cards removed: builder content is now just the investor decks. MBA Forecast Commentary is found from MBA's archive page, wherever MBA stores it.
New card: Builder investor decks. The newest slide decks (not filings) from D.R. Horton, Lennar, Taylor Morrison, KB Home, Green Brick and Dream Finders, plus Pulte and Toll when they post one.
